messages:
jamie h: Anyone else hit a publish failure on release/1.17? regen-check removed our onboarding sample changelog line and the publish gate aborted.

ci-bot: GH Actions · publish-typegen · FAILED
Job: regen-check -> non-empty diff detected
Logs: `CHANGELOG.md: removed line 'Added: sample onboarding - auth retry example'`

olga n: I can repro. The commit that added the sample is in the branch, `yarn typegen` adds the line locally, but `node scripts/changelog-clean.js` later strips it.

devex-bot: typegen v2.6.8 · Generated files changed: CHANGELOG.md; contributors sorted

patrick s: We rolled a contributor-normalize + dedupe change last week. The cleanup normalizes by dropping parentheticals like `(via sample-app)` so the example becomes identical to an older line and gets deduped away.

jamie h: Argh. We intentionally add that bullet to force a minor bump. semver-detector now sees no user-visible change and skips the bump.

olga n: Short-term unblock options: (A) push a temporary token on the changelog line like `[dx-preserve]`, (B) insert a sentinel comment `<!-- keep-changelog-example -->` so cleanup knows to keep it.

patrick s: I prefer sentinel comment but we need to update the sample-app generator + onboarding docs. I can open a quick PR to add sentinel output and update the template.

typegen-bot: Created PR #1788: "regendiff-guard: replay typegen+cleanup in same image"

ci-bot: created issue #1789: "cleanup dedupe removes sample bullets causing semver false-negative" (assigned to patrick s)

jamie h: Longer-term fixes: (1) compute dedupe keys that preserve parentheticals when the bullet mentions `sample|Example|sample-app`, (2) add a regendiff CI guard that runs both typegen and cleanup in the same job image to avoid cross-job drift, (3) teach semver-detector to consider normalize/cleanup deltas as visible changes or provide a flag like `--respect-normalize-delta`.

patrick s: Plan: update dedupe key logic so it includes parenthetical content for bullets matching the sample/example heuristic. Add unit tests and a fixture showing the earlier failure. I'll also land the regendiff guard script `tools/regendiff_guard.sh` that runs: `yarn typegen && node scripts/changelog-clean.js && git --no-pager diff -- CHANGELOG.md` and fails if diff != 0.

olga n: Also add a CI job that runs the replay in the same container used by publish-typegen. I hit this because my local node version behaved slightly differently than the runner image; a single-image replay would have caught it.

jamie h: Good. semver-detector flag lets us be conservative in the short term while tooling stabilizes. Please add that flag and wire it into the publish job.

patrick s: I'll open two PRs: one to changelog-clean (dedupe fix + tests + guard script) and one to semver-detector (`--respect-normalize-delta`). Meanwhile I pushed a temp commit adding `[dx-preserve]` to the sample line and retriggered publish so we don't block the release.

ci-bot: re-run triggered by patrick s: publish-typegen · queued

typegen-bot: typegen v2.6.9 · Generated files changed: CHANGELOG.md

patrick s: Quick update: changelog-clean PR merged with tests and guard. semver-detector flag PR opened, will follow up. I also created a tiny onboarding change to add `<!-- keep-changelog-example -->` to the sample generator template.

ci-bot: publish-typegen job passed on re-run with temporary `[dx-preserve]` suffix.

olga n: After the semver PR lands, remove the temp suffix and re-run the publish job to confirm clean state. Also adding a note in devex/onboarding.md explaining the sentinel and why parentheticals sometimes matter.

jamie h: Thanks all. Leaving a release-board todo to remove the temp token after semver merge. :thumbsup:

patrick s: follow-ups: (1) add a CI assertion that sample generator outputs the sentinel by default, (2) update sample-app README to mention changelog expectations, (3) monitor future regendiff flakes for 2 weeks.

devex-bot: Task DX-510 created: "add changelog sentinel in sample generator" (owner: olga n)

jamie h: closing loop for now. If anyone sees a similar regen diff, please paste `git show <sha>` and the output of `node scripts/changelog-clean.js` so we can triage quickly.
